controls: must add value beyond market, sector, liquidity and price-momentum effects

data_source.vendor_cap: the feed returns at most 200 rows per stock, most recent first, so very heavily dealt stocks are truncated; this must be reported as a coverage limitation.
data_source.why_not_nse: nidp.bulk_deals/block_deals come from NSE's ROLLING bulk.csv, which cannot yield history: measured 2026-10-22 at 7 days of bulk and 2 of block, with zero overlap with the study window.

deal_feature_rules.bounds: the deal contribution is bounded SEPARATELY from the holdings overlay so neither can dominate and each can be ablated independently
deal_feature_rules.confidence: lower confidence where the counterparty or ultimate beneficial owner is unclear; a single-client signal is damped as the holdings overlay already does
deal_feature_rules.evidence_claim: a disclosed deal evidences that a TRANSACTION occurred, never that an institution is accumulating with a bullish view
features: deal intensity vs turnover and free float
repeat buying by the same client and by independent clients over fixed lookbacks
deal_feature_rules.offsetting_transfers_excluded: legs matching an opposite-action leg on the same (symbol, date, quantity, price) are paired off before any net flow is computed. Measured on the first 38 symbols: 46.8% of symbol-days were PURE transfers with zero net demand.
deal_feature_rules.point_in_time: a deal may only be used for scoring dates STRICTLY AFTER its trade date. Exchanges publish after the close and the feed carries no publication timestamp, so same-day use is forbidden.
deal_feature_rules.sides_kept_separate: buyer and seller legs stored and counted separately; distinct client counts, not leg counts

failure_policy: if the C-vs-B increment is not positive out of sample, deals are retained as market-intelligence CONTEXT and must not influence the score. No horizon, subset or threshold may be reselected after seeing results; that requires a new study_id.

hurdle.note: inherits 001's +1.0 pp framing for the A->B comparison; the C-vs-B increment has no preset pp hurdle and is judged on a credible positive out-of-sample estimate

hypothesis.H0: adding a bounded bulk/block deal feature does not improve net 20-session incremental return beyond the mutual-fund holdings tilt (Model B)
hypothesis.H1: Model C (baseline + MF holdings + deal feature) beats Model B by a positive, credible margin out of sample

models.B: baseline + bounded MF holdings overlay (the NIDP-SM-VALIDATION-001 tilt)
models.C: Model B + a SEPARATELY bounded bulk/block deal feature

primary_test: ablation C vs B on identical dates, universe and constraints. C vs A is reported but is NOT the test: the question is incremental value beyond holdings, not whether large deals look bullish.
why_a_separate_study: NIDP-SM-VALIDATION-001 is frozen and immutable by trigger. Adding a hypothesis to it after the fact is exactly what preregistration exists to prevent, so the bulk/block deal feature is registered as its own versioned experiment with its own holdout. 001's acceptance criteria are unchanged.
